games.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
games.description: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.title: FreeStyle Football 2
games.description: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

games.title: Rayman Legends Retold
games.description: Відкрийте сміливе переосмислення улюбленого платформера з оновленою графікою та свіжим поглядом на знайомий сюжет. Грайте в соло-режимі або збирайте компанію до 4 осіб для гри в кооперативному режимі на одній консолі. Досліджуйте таємничий новий світ, проходьте нові музичні рівні та багато іншого!

games.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.description: Тіні — ваші союзники. Поверніться до міста як майстер-злодій Garrett у цій оновленій класичній грі від Nightdive Studios. Крадіжки, підступні витівки та хитрощі у світі, де довіра — це розкіш, а кожна вкрадена таємниця має свою ціну.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.title: A-Train 9 PRIME LINE
games.description: The ultimate edition of the city-building simulation game A-Train 9! As the president of a railway company, build the city of your dreams through city building and railway management. A-Train 9 PRIME LINE takes city building beyond evolution, delivering the ultimate city-building experience.

games.title: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
games.description: Станьте частиною історії від початку до грандіозного фіналу серії ігор Attack on Titan. Гра з використанням пристрою просторового маневрування (ODM) стала ще просунутішою й забезпечує найзахопливіші та найстильніші бої в історії серії.

games.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.description: Нова пригода в серії фентезійних ігор із головоломками «Професор Лейтон», продажі якої перевищили 20 млн копій у всьому світі. Професор Лейтон і Люк беруться за загадкову справу в Стім-Байсоні — місті винаходів, що працює завдяки паровим технологіям.

games.title: STAGE TOUR
games.description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

games.title: Salticidae Story
games.description: A cosy jumping-spider keeping game. Feed them, mist them, and help them through every moult. Breed lines through a 120-trait genome and six species, catch wild jumping spiders, beetles, roaches and mantises, dress your Keeper, and play online with friends.

games.title: Feudums
games.description: Feudums — це симулятор середньовічної стратегії з унікальною системою васалітету, повною підтримкою модифікації та розповіддями, які створюватиме игрова спільнота. Збалансуйте дипломатичні, економічні та військові аспекти, борючись за трон. Чи судилося вам правити?

games.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
games.description: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

games.title: Arizona Sunshine®
games.description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

games.title: Tropico 7
games.description: Все або нічого! У Tropico 7 ви знову взуваєте блискучі черевики Ель-Президента, щоб розбудувати свою острівну державу і - в буквальному сенсі - звернути гори. Як славний лідер, ви ведете своїх вірних громадян (і свій рахунок у швейцарському банку) до невимовного процвітання.

games.title: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.description: Пробивайтеся крізь спотворені світи разом зі своїм супутником, драконом-богом, у насиченому адреналіном пригодницькому платформері, що поєднує вільний ближній бій, пливкий платформінг і науково-фантастичні дослідження. Станьте обранцем занепалого бога, Ельти.

games.title: Sheep Tag 2
games.description: Your friends are sheep. You are the wolf. Hunt them down as they build ridiculous farm fortresses to keep you out. Sheep Tag 2 is a Free-To-Play chaotic team-based RTS that's easy to learn and brutal to master. Play solo with bots or battle multiplayer with up to 32 players. Build. Hunt. Survive.

games.title: METRO 2039
games.description: METRO 2039 — новий знаковий шутер від першої особи від 4A Games, визнаних майстрів оповіді. Вирушайте в саме серце темної постапокаліптичної Москви, де на вас чекає жорстоке протистояння, від якого залежить доля Метро.

games.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.description: Отримайте задоволення від приголомшливого рімейку першої пригоди Лари Крофт і відкрийте загублені таємниці Атлантиди завдяки неймовірній графіці, сучасному ігровому процесу та сюрпризам, які зберігають дух оригіналу.

games.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
games.description: A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.

games.title: Persona 4 Revival
games.description: Pre-order now and receive exclusive bonuses that will elevate your Persona 4 Revival experience! Early purchasers will unlock the P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set, featuring iconic music tracks from Persona 3 Reload and Persona 5 Royal that will be available for selection within the game. Persona 4 Revival: P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set Persona 3 Reload BGMs include: 1. Dungeon BGM: Basement (P3R ver.) 2. Boss Battle BGM: Heartful Cry 3. Result BGM: After the Battle (P3R ver.) Persona 5 Royal BGMs include: 1. Dungeon BGM: The Whi

games.title: Fable
games.description: Станьте героєм власних мрій в цій атмосферній рольовій грі з відкритим світом, де кожне рішення впливає на ваш шлях, репутація важливіша за все інше, а щасливий кінець ніхто не гарантує.

games.title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
games.description: Atelier Karia розповідає про шукачку пригод, яка втратила спогади й мусить зіткнутися з минулим. Нові функції урізноманітнюють битви й алхімію. Синтезовані згодяться в дослідженнях, а інгредієнти дають різні ефекти.

games.title: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
games.description: Станьте пілотом, яким вам судилося бути. Змініть долю людства в GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, динамічному екшені, що по-новому розкриває Gundam через кінематографічну історію та нищівні бої.

games.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
games.description: Із полум’я війни постає фенікс. Рольова гра у жанрі темного фентезі Three Kingdoms від Team NINJA. Опануйте акробатичні прийоми китайських бойових мистецтві підкоріть безкраї поля битв у Three Kingdoms, де вам протистоятимуть могутні генерали й demons.

games.title: Altiros
games.description: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

games.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
games.description: У ліках, що дарують життя, прихована отрута. ПРО ГРУ Виготовляйте трав'яні ліки й покладайтеся на кмітливість і дедукцію, щоб розкрити правду про «П'ять таємниць» і «П'ять проклять» — дві низки дивних явищ і змов, що сіють хаос у задньому палаці, кварталі розваг і на вулицях столиці. Аптекарці Maomao доведеться застосувати всю свою кмітливість і знання, щоб розгадати таємниці й розкрити правду про фальшивого брата імператора. ЗБИРАЙТЕ ЗАЧІПКИ Й РОЗГАДУЙТЕ ТАЄМНИЦІ Опитуйте свідків, проводьте розслідування на місцях

games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
games.description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.title: Kids of Karendow
games.description: Kids of Karendow is a pixel-art fantasy sci-fi JRPG about a war built on lies. Play both sides: join Elmo, a resistance fighter who can't look away from injustice, and Kommander Krewl, the Daughter of Death, as the truth forces former enemies together against something far worse.

games.title: _Xodus
games.description: _Xodus is an exploration into the end of the world.

games.title: About how he earned a suite from T-Financial Platform in four months
games.description: Story about how he earned a suite from T-Financial Platform in four months.All characters appearing in this work are fictitious. Any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, is purely coincidental.

games.title: Afterdays
games.description: Formerly AfterMath - a post-apoc text-based game: A week has past since the Doomsday apocalypse reeked hell upon earth on December 21, 2012. You finally have awoken in your underground bomb shelter to learn of what remains of the world around you.

games.title: Age of Ascent
games.description: Age of Ascent: Arrival is a new space co-op and combat game featuring direct-piloting solo and co-op missions and real-time PvE and PvP battles set in stunning space scenes.

games.title: Age of seas
games.description: Space Thieves embarks you on a stellar mission to collect materials through an open world universe, meet the requirements of the demand, create your transport routes and beware of space thieves, many wait to get quick money, since transporting the loads by space can be very dangerous at times.

games.title: Alive
games.description: Welcome to Alive , a Third person Cover based shooter. Bring in your friends and join the battle to become the best player, you will get the opportunity to pull off your skills and make your way to the top of the Leader board by earning XPs!

games.title: Allwheel.online
games.description: Allwheel.online gives the player the opportunity to feel like a rally car pilot, as well as independently or in company with friends to overcome off-road relying on their skills and mutual assistance.

games.title: Annihilation
games.description: Annihilation is Character Based 60 Players Battle Royale and 5v5 online shooter game.You have to focus on surviving and understand your operator's skills to be the Last Man Standing.

games.title: Arcano
games.description: Arcano is an over the top action adventure in VR. Playing as a secret agent, you'll make the impossible possible. Slow-motion shootouts and crazy stunts at a variety of exciting locations — all with online co-op.

games.title: ARCANORUM 231
games.description: A journey into a mystical underworld and immersive occult art and ritual. Featuring artwork by Barry William Hale, music by NOKO210, and drumming, chanting, and invocations by a number of other practicing occultists.

games.title: Army Ops
games.description: Army Ops is the spiritual successor to America's Army, delivering authentic tactical gameplay, team-based combat, and strategic objectives. Dive into immersive battles with dynamic maps, deep lore, and classic military shooter mechanics—no pay-to-win, no skill based matchmaking - just skill.

games.title: As If Dreaming When You're Wide Awake
games.description: As If is a narrative game portraying issues revolving around mental health. Experience the life of Matthew as he struggles to reach his dreams and wishes. Step into his shoes. Look from his eyes. Listen to the voices. Feel his frustrations. Packaged in artistic symbolisms and realistic grit.

games.title: Ascend
games.description: Ascend is a first-person VR Arena Shooter where you rise to greatness in a crucible of visceral and kinetic combat. Rise above your enemies by engaging in intense aerial warfare and leverage the power of VR with our unique lean motion flight system.

games.title: Awakening of Dragon
games.description: Awakening of Dragon是一款龙题材、西方魔幻ARPG+MMO手游，游戏的一切围绕“龙”展开。来自异世界的勇者继承龙神之力，拥有人龙双形态变身能力。在战斗中，勇者既可以召唤巨龙进行战斗；也可以化身半龙半人的龙神，衍生出不同的战斗能力。除此之外，游戏拥有龙坐骑、龙宠物、龙装备等搜集养成元素，支持自由交易、跨服盟战等多人玩法，共同打造巨龙的世界。

games.title: Battle Mech Frontier
games.description: Battle Mech Frontier is a turn-based artillery game where two teams face each-other over a fully-destructible terrain and try different strategies to knock each other out until only one side is standing.

games.title: Battledroid
games.description: Become the commander of a mighty army of fearsome battledroids, and watch them fight in epic battles of mass destruction. Create your defences and test their strength, or send your forces to crush those of your friends and enemies online!

games.title: BEAT.R.
games.description: 3D blocks exploding everywhere while colors and sounds delight you in every way. This infinite runner is sure to grab your attention for at least 30 seconds.

games.title: Beatographer: Beatmap all Music
games.description: Join a crowd of music and VR rhythm game enthusiasts in the noble quest to beatmap all music using the best VR beatmapping tool available on the planet. Supports all styles: Punching, slicing, shooting, dancing! Feel the beat, create the map, become #1 in the leaderboards!

games.title: Beyond Arm's Reach
games.description: Beyond Arm’s Reach is an action adventure game, set in a 1950’s steampunk universe. You have to use the physics based grappling hook, to navigate around the world, defeat enemies and solve puzzles along the way.

games.title: BlindOak Prow
games.description: BlindOak Prow is a competitive strategy card game with unique, subtle tactics that mirror the political maneuvers of the setting. Form a party of four characters mixing and matching the six different classes however you'd like, then outwit your foes for control of the city and for your survival on a new land.

games.title: Blockiverse: Camouflage
games.description: Blockiverse: Camouflage combines all the great features of modern hero shooters, mixes in a lot of characters, and add a ton of environmental interaction to create an over-the-top, fun experience.

games.title: Blue Pill Glitch
games.description: Enter the simulation with friends to locate Meow & get to the bottom of the Blue Pill Glitch! Blue Pill Glitch is a online multiplayer game where you need to locate Meow before its too late. You get dropped off in the center of the city & are tasked to search through buildings to find Meows apartment, but there is a problem. The Suits stand in your way & fight you trying to prevent you from finding Meow. Link up with up to 8 friends & find Meow before its too late!

games.title: BoltHalt
games.description: “BoltHalt” is the story of a protagonist being mute upon waking up in a hospital room. Their left and right brain (logical and emotional) speak to them, convincing him/her to make certain logical or emotional driven decisions which progress the story.

games.title: Bonk & Chomp
games.description: Bonk & Chomp is a fast-paced 6-player party brawler where everyone fights for one giant cookie! Bonk rivals to knock them silly, steal the snack, and chomp as much as you can before the cookie's gone.

games.title: Bottle Flip VR
games.description: Master the ancient art of bottle flipping to escape the room! Land flips on targets to unlock new challenges and locations. Every successful flip will earn you coins that can be used to unlock new throwables. - Unique Locations - Multiple game modes (adventure, speed-run, time trial, score-chaser, etc) - Unlockable bottles/throwables

games.title: Build a Game Universe
games.description: Build a Game Universe is your spot to build, play, share and sell your 2D games and game content. Whether you are an experienced developer or just getting started, our intuitively designed tools create a fun and exciting environment to bring your imagination to life!

games.title: BULLETGROUNDS
games.description: від третього обличя шутер що має безкласовий характерний геймплей.Налаштуйте власне унікальне спорядження з різної зброі, гаджетів, здібностей, навичків та модів це допоможе вам та вашій команді перемогти.

games.title: Buratino
games.description: Buratino is a 2D arcade game with light adventure elements for the ZX Spectrum 8-bit computer. It is loosely based on the characters and storyline from the book by same title by Alexei Tolstoi, a well-known Russian author, renowned mostly for his early science fiction and historical prose.

games.title: C.A.S.T (Combat Alchemy Solution and Tactics)
games.description: C.A.S.T is a fast paced, 2D arena fighter where you combine elements to cast spells and disassemble your enemies. You have a multitude of spells at your disposal. Ranging from defensive to full offensive! The arena is yours to own!

games.title: Carmine Impact
games.description: Carmine Impact is a new, fast-paced arena shooter by HarpNet Studios! Carmine brings you the best of an era gone by, with a modern twist (and cute anime girls (soon))! A game about shooting everything, anime girls, and insane movement. Welcome to the future.

games.title: Citywars Savage
games.description: Citywars Savage is a fast paced Couch MMO Tower Defense featuring split screen, crafting and classless combat system. Go on adventures to complete quests, level up your gear and fight savage PvE battles with your friends. Establish and decorate your city with your most valuable riches.

games.title: Clash of Magic: Spectator Only
games.description: On the United Island of Magic, there is an Academy of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Students with magic powers, regardless of their ethnicity and background, can apply to this university. The acceptance rate is lower than Harvard.

games.title: Consortya
games.description: The game features social spaces where real musical artists will be performing live music. The adventure and combat bolster this experience and allow Balancers to collect hidden songs from upcoming performers. Consortya is being designed and developed by Andy Martin of indie studio Moonlight Games, LLC.

games.title: Contact Spotted
games.description: Contact Spotted is a tactical 5 vs 5 first-person shooter where you will have to rely on your teammates to complete your task. You will be deployed on a map as a law-enforcement officer or a terrorist and engage in different gamemodes, everything from bomb defusal to zone defending.

games.title: COSH
games.description: Space battles are not for the faint-hearted. Collect your team out of cyborgs, maniacs or sociopaths, infected with alien collective intelligence, and manage not to lose it in the race for resources.

games.title: Country Clubbing
games.description: Are your lack of golf skills stressing you out? Are you slicing when you’d rather be beating the other players? Are local gopher populations threatening the well being of your local ranges? Well then, why not try Country Clubbing! Swing to your heart’s content and throw caution (and par) to the wind!

games.title: Curre
games.description: Gamemode: players can creat their own Casino throughout CREATOR mode, edit your map and upload it to the server. Other players will race in your space and run for freedom. With them racing, you can earn your own jettons, or lose them if they succeed.

games.title: Cyberspace: Infinite／赛博空间：无限
games.description: Cyberspace: Infinity is a strategy-oriented idle game. Multiple automatic combat systems can be easily played without complex operations. Dominate the world with your legendary team, let your enemies know who is the real champion of cyberspace!

games.title: Dark Inside
games.description: Didn't we all want to do illegal things? Enter, plunder and leave! It is full of actions and fears even if it seems funny. Are we gonna find the statue that we seek and leave this abandoned town alive? Then who is gonna be the winner at the end of the day? Keep what you got and leave or stay and fight for more!

games.title: Dark War
games.description: Dark War - New fantasy MMORPG! New free online fantasy MMORPG Dark War is coming! Let's have a quick look. After downloading the mini client in short time, you can then start right into the game. From the first minute you're trapped in a compelling storyline and have to fight against various creatures of the underworld to move forward.

games.title: DARKROOM
games.description: DARKROOM is a mystic novel. You wake up in complete darkness and you don’t know where you are or how you got there. Yet, there is someone else in this dark room.

games.title: Darkwinds
games.description: In this new online card game, you must sail the dangerous seas of Thard, infested with ferocious pirates, dark spells and terrible creatures that will seek to sink you into the depths of oblivion. To survive, you must choose your crew wisely and create a powerful deck to defeat your opponents in order to become the most respected pirate...

games.title: Datascape
games.description: Third-person casual platformer set within a virtual, endless void known as the Datascape. You are are generic program avatar, broken but not deleted. Journey through the Datascape to discover your function and purpose.

games.title: Deathless Heroes
games.description: Unique mix of Collectible Card Game and Turn based RPG Enter into the multidimensional world of fantasy, scifi and historic creatures and events. Collect cards, build deck with best tactic and dominate the Deathless World. Expect more than another card game. You choose guaranteed cards to start with! You choose which colors you want to increase. Cards contain many abilities and open up endless possibilities for combinations. The hero has abilities that he can use as often as you want. Choose cards that you can use

games.title: Dominus - Multiplayer Sim Turn Based Strategy
games.description: Dominus is a turn-based tactics and strategy game with a unique twist. Inspired by strategy legends like Civilization, Dominus focuses that epic 'just one more turn' gameplay into rapid multiplayer mayhem lasting from 5 minute squad battles to epic half-hour struggles between empires.

games.title: Dreamshard: Prologue
games.description: Dreamshard is a roguelike card game that blends rogue-like deck builders with CCG. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, fight monsters, craft a unique deck, and defeat your enemies to find the secret of the Dreamshard.

games.title: Drone Zone
games.description: Multiplayer team-based tactical shooter in a postapocaliptic world. This is not FPV drones. Future. Technology assists in managing flight and targeting. Fight for resources in a world full of hostile anomalies. Use active skills and get advantage depending on which enemy module you have destroyed.

games.title: Eggs & Kings
games.description: SYSYGY`s Eggs & Kings - this is an unrealistic hardcore game that will explode your computer! Grab your gamepad and a lot of patience! You will have to destroy crowds of monsters, collecting their precious eggs.

games.title: Elerena
games.description: Elerena is a magic-based dungeon crawler that hosts a variety of magic and enemies. With currently 3 different schools of magic that offer unique and interesting playstyles, and more as the game thrives, there is a type of magic for everyone to enjoy as they rain down hell on the enemies they face.

games.title: Elisius
games.description: The Time Lord has taken iconic warriors of history to Elisius! Play with friends as a Viking, Cowboy, Samurai, and more to fight against the various monsters the Time Lord has conjured and acquire different historical weapons. Participation is mandatory, but gold and glory are guaranteed!

games.title: Empis
games.description: Empis is a turn-based strategy game that focuses on short and sweet multiplayer matches. Choose from individual factions each with their own unique units and upgrades, unlock technology, and build sprawling cities with buildings and fortifications.

games.title: Era
games.description: Era is a Free to Play PC title, combining the card game genre with team-based turn based RPG elements; a hybrid between Hearthstone and Final Fantasy. The player gathers Characters, finds Skill Cards, crafts Weapons and creates a team of up to four characters to fight battles against other players, or AI in daily tasks and quests. When the player first starts the game, they create an account and choose their preferred Faction. The player can then create a team of up to four characters. Characters can be summoned by

games.title: Escape from Zellman Orbital
games.description: Escape the Room - in outer space! From a lab cell on an orbital space station, make your way back to your ship, and get out... before something terrible happens! Story-Heavy escape-the-room style gameplay, in a sci-fi horror setting.

games.title: Fate of Stars
games.description: Welcome to Fate of Stars, a PvP auto-battler collectible game with unique inventory management mechanics! Collect heroes, craft powerful items, and battle other players in strategic duels!

games.title: Fatman Simulator
games.description: Fatman Simulator is a simulation game in which you can experience the life of a overweight programmer. Try your best to lose weight and earn a better life!

games.title: FEN: Prologue
games.description: FEN: Prologue is a new interpretation of the survival genre. After a sequence of unexpected events you find yourself at an unauthorized landfill. The fen where the landfill is located will become your new home. You will have to try hard in order to survive in this horrible place.

games.title: Forbidden Game
games.description: Fair free to play collectible card game in dark fantasy setting. 'On the edge of the world, on the very border with the Abyss, mysterious masters of the Forbidden Game are looking for new disciples who could stand on their side in an endless game of existence.'

games.title: Free Royale
